programme.desc: In southern China, at the foot of the Himalayas, Martyna Wojciechowska visits the Mosuo tribe.In their culture, there is no concept of father or husband, and the role of the head of the house is played by women who make all important decisions.They never marry, and their surnames are inherited by all family members.The traveler meets LaSuo, who lives with her daughter, mother, grandmother and uncle.The woman's father stays with her own mother, as do her daughters.Martyna will also learn the Mosuo dance, in which the first declarations are made between a man and a woman.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: In Bulgaria, Martyna visits a traditional family belonging to the small Kalajj ethnic group.Only 18,000 of them live in the country.The Kalajjs care very much about the purity of the group, and they arrange marriages only between their own kin.The young people get to know each other and observe each other for years, and if a bachelor catches the eye of a girl, negotiations begin.Every year, everyone comes to the area of ​​Stara Zagora on Saint Theodore's Day.Martyna meets 19-year-old Vasylka.The girl will present herself at this year's virgin market.The traveler accompanies her in preparations, during which they choose a dress and bake a traditional cake.He also learns about the amazing customs of the Kalajj people, their financial negotiations and the type of test that is supposed to prove that the bride has actually remained chaste until her wedding night.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: The World Health Organization estimates that there are approximately 170,000 people with vitiligo in Tanzania.Albinos are very susceptible to burns and skin cancer.Many of them die before the age of 40.The threat is not only from the harsh African sun, but also from other people.In Tanzania, it is common to believe that the body of an albino has magical powers.Hunting of them is becoming more and more common.Martyna visits a school where a hundred children suffering from vitiligo study.He also meets 19-year-old Kabula.A girl aged 12 was brutally attacked.After the incident, she is determined to become a lawyer and defend the rights of people affected by albinism in the future.Together with Martyna, they will visit her parents, whom she has not seen for 5 years.Previously, the girl did not have the courage to come home.

programme.desc: In each episode of the program, Martyna Wojciechowska confirms that all women have their own extraordinary story.The traveler finds those that surprise the most by visiting the most remote corners of the world, including:in Bhutan, Nigeria, Papua, Russia and Colombia.Viewers meet 47-year-old Percy from the Philippines, a deeply religious Catholic who undergoes crucifixion during Easter.Filipinos consider it a form of penance for their sins.On the same continent lives Jyoti, who suffers from achondroplasia.The disease causes bone development disorders and dwarfism.Ashi Sonam Choden Dorji, from a royal family, lives in Bhutan.The team will check if she actually lives like a princess.The main character of the program will also be a woman from Sulawesi who died on July 1, 2014.Her story will be told by her sister, Yohana In the first episode, Martyna will visit India.The main character of the program will be Jyoti Amge, who is 21 years old and only 63 centimeters tall.She is a real record holder, proclaimed the smallest woman in the world.Her height hasn't changed much since birth.The girl's parents tried to help her - to no avail.Indian doctors diagnosed Jyoti with growth hormone deficiency and achondroplasia - a genetic disease that is associated with disorders in the structure and development of bones, as well as with dwarfism.Jyoti's bones are weak, brittle, some permanently damaged.The girl will show Martyna what everyday life looks like from her perspective.He will also talk about obstacles and fulfilling his dreams of a career in Hollywood.She has already performed, among others,in the series "American Horror Story", alongside Jessica Lang.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska once again sets out on a fascinating journey to learn about different aspects of the lives of women living in distant corners of the world.Some of the points of the route in this edition will be India, Senegal, South Korea, South Africa, Israel and Mexico.The program participants will talk about their everyday lives and reveal intimate secrets to the traveler.Some of them will be truly moving.This season, the journalist will look at how the Orthodox Jewish community functions on a daily basis and how they celebrate the joyful holiday of Purim.He will visit a nursing home for women who were once involved in prostitution.Although this profession is legal in Mexico, women are not entitled to any benefits.The traveler will also meet teenage Karolina, who works almost 24 hours a day at a garbage dump, and in South Africa she will meet a girl who dives with sharks.These are just some of the many amazing experiences that await Martyna Wojciechowska Kinnar have been present in Indian culture for four thousand years.They are called divine dancers.These half-people, half-birds appear in Hindu mythology and Buddhism.Eunuchs often ensured the safety of wives in the courts of Indian rulers.Nowadays, recently married couples and parents of newborn children seek their blessing.On the one hand, the Kinnar are revered during religious and spiritual ceremonies, but on the other hand, they are cursed and discriminated against.Martyna Wojciechowska visits Ram Kali, which runs a non-governmental organization that provides support to the Kinnar community and fights for their rights.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: On August 4, 2020, a powerful explosion occurred in the capital of Lebanon, Beirut.Almost 200 people died, thousands were injured, and 300,000 city residents lost their homes.The tragedy was caused by the explosion of 2,750 tons of domestic saltpeter, previously confiscated and stored in the port.A small Middle Eastern country - which has been struggling for years with the economic crisis, corruption, poverty and unemployment, and the problem of Syrian refugees - was unable to cope with the enormity of the destruction left after the explosion.The whole world supported him, but many months passed before the city was rebuilt.One of the people who supported the injured was volunteer Zena Chahine.She is the first woman in the Lebanese volunteer fire brigade.Following her example, dozens of other brave ladies entered the service.To this day, ignoring the danger, he does everything to rebuild his beloved city.
